01-22.t: 佳士得（Christie's）在倫敦拍賣了傑夫·貝克（Jeff Beck）的九十把吉他，同時拍賣的還有超過四十件他個人收藏的其他物品。
01-22.en: Ninety of Beck's guitars were auctioned by Christie's on London on 22 January 2025, along with over 40 other items from his personal collection.

05-12.t: 吉米·罕醉克斯（Jimi Hendrix）的首張專輯《Are You Experienced》在英國發行後，在排行榜上停留了三十三週，最高名次達到第二名。
05-12.en: Released in the UK on May 12, 1967, Are You Experienced spent 33 weeks on the charts, peaking at number two.

06-03.t: 布萊恩·梅（Brian May）在伊莉莎白二世（Elizabeth II）金禧慶典上，登上白金漢宮（Buckingham Palace）屋頂吉他獨奏〈God Save the Queen〉。
06-03.en: As part of the Golden Jubilee of Elizabeth II celebrations on 3 June 2002, May performed a guitar solo of "God Save the Queen" from the roof of Buckingham Palace, with the performance appearing on the 30th Anniversary DVD edition of A Night at the Opera.

07-02.t: 平克·佛洛伊德（Pink Floyd）與羅傑·華特斯（Roger Waters）重新聚首，在 Live 8 登台演出。這場演出帶動了精選專輯《Echoes: The Best of Pink Floyd》銷量的增加。
07-02.en: On 2 July 2005, Pink Floyd reunited with Waters to perform at Live 8.

11-07.t: 大衛·吉爾摩（David Gilmour）與尼克·梅森（Nick Mason）重新審視了先前與理查·萊特（Richard Wright）在《The Division Bell》錄音期間製作的錄音，藉此創作了全新的平克·佛洛伊德（Pink Floyd）專輯《The Endless River》。
11-07.en: Gilmour and Mason revisited recordings made with Wright during the Division Bell sessions to create a new Pink Floyd album, The Endless River, released on 7 November 2014.

11-10.t: 黑色安息日（Black Sabbath）在倫敦聖安妮法院的三叉戟錄音室（Trident Studios）錄製了歌曲〈Evil Woman〉與其 B 面曲〈Wicked World〉。
11-10.en: The band recorded the song "Evil Woman" and its B-side '"Wicked World" on 10 November 1969 at Trident Studios on St.
